configuration.fit: TMLE(learned_rule=LearnedRule(), cross_fit=False, cv_evaluation=False, g_bounds='auto', random_state=<fit seed>) at n = 2000; repeats=1
configuration.outcome_learner: InteractionLogistic: PolynomialFeatures(2, interaction_only=True, include_bias=False) then LogisticRegression(C=1e6, max_iter=5000, tol=1e-10) on (A, W1, W2), in a class marked cleverly_learner_family = 'parametric'
configuration.support_key: splitting ('in_sample',), outcome_learner_family 'parametric', treatment_learner_family 'parametric', checked on every fit

laws.misspecified_limit: RM30 law with blip 0.8 W1 + W1^2 - 0.3

configuration.variance: {n (n - 1)}^-1 sum_i (phi_i - phibar)^2, phibar = 0 to solver tolerance; the factor n / (n - 1) = 1.0005 over n^-2 sum_i phi_i^2
configuration.truth: per replication: refit the outcome learner on every row with the package's fit_on_rows, require the fit's rule on every row (rule L4), and integrate the rule's value by the trapezoid rule on 4001 points of W1 for each W2, with the known Qbar0
configuration.oracle_se: sqrt(Var_P0 D*(d_n, Qbar0, g0) / n) at the fit's rule; descriptive
configuration.interpolating_control: DecisionTreeClassifier(min_samples_leaf=1, random_state=0) with predict_proba clipped to [0.01, 0.99], no family marker, fitted in sample on the same draw
configuration.targeting_necessity: WithoutW1MainLogistic: logistic on (A, W2, A W1, A W2), marked parametric; the control is the same fit's initial plug-in mean of Qbar(d_n(W_i), W_i)
configuration.weak_limit_necessity: the same pair with DropW1Logistic (RM30's drop_w1_learner, marked parametric), whose limit blip is weak at n = 2000; diagnostic, no verdict; the summary publishes the share of draws whose rule differs from the limit rule (truth != WEAK_LIMIT_RULE_VALUE) and the targeted arm's mean error on settled and on flipped draws, in the targeted arm's error SD
configuration.target_distinction: the declared estimate and interval of each law read against (1/10) sum_v Psi_{d_v}(P0), d_v the declared learner's plug-in rule on the training rows of make_folds(n, 10, random_state=<fold seed>); descriptive
